entry.author: KiwiRail
entry.summary:
on March 24, we were proud to join key stakeholders to welcome the Minister for Rail, Rt Hon Winston Peters, who officially opened the new state of the art Waltham Maintenance Hub in Christchurch, delivered through a $110 million Government investment.
 
The event also showcased the first of the new low emission, higher powered DM locomotives, currently being built by Stadler in Spain. The Government has committed $533 million for 66 DM locomotives, with 47 replacing the ageing South Island fleet, as part of a wider $1.2 billion investment in South Island rail since 2019.
 
The Waltham hub provides a modern, safe and efficient working environment for our people and will support maintenance of KiwiRail’s locomotives, wagons and passenger carriages operating across the South Island.
 
More efficient maintenance, combined with a more reliable and modern locomotive fleet, will deliver better, more consistent services for our South Island customers and we’re excited about what this means for the continued growth of rail in the South.
